rules.sentence: This carries a worse prognosis in chronic schizophrenia.[30]
There are associations between sex, younger age, parkinsonism, and negative symptoms of schizophrenia with catatonia.[10][30]

Given that acute catatonia can have its origin with medical or neurological illnesses, initial monitoring with vitals signs notation and treatment with intravenous fluids and nasogastric tubes are warranted.
Complications can include aspiration pneumonia, dehydration, embolisms, pressure ulcers, and malnutrition.
